description_en: Enables an Express Connect circuit that is in the Confirmed state. After the circuit is enabled, it enters the Enabled state
description_zh: 开通处于Confirmed状态的物理专线，开通完成后物理专线进入Enabled状态
kebab_example: aliyun vpc enable-physical-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-2zeoaxkq3x0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnablePhysicalConnection

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Express Connect circuit resides.

You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域。

您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value of this parameter. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip the SP (sales and billing system) billing order flow and directly enable the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:
false (default): Standard flow. A billing order is automatically created when the circuit is enabled. The circuit enters the Enabled state after the order is created.
true: Skips the billing order and directly enables the circuit. This capability is available only to whitelist accounts
parameters.help_zh:
是否跳过 SP（售卖计费系统）计费订单流程直接开通物理专线。取值：
false（默认）：标准流程，开通专线时自动创建计费订单，订单创建成功后专线进入 Enabled 状态。
true：跳过计费订单直接开通，该能力仅对白名单账号开放
parameters.name: by_pass_sp
